cases.note: The common case. Nothing awkward about it

cases.name: minimum
cases.note: Eight bytes, the shortest Zitadel accepts by default

cases.name: non_ascii

cases.name: trailing_space

cases.name: bytes_71
cases.note: One under the bcrypt input limit

cases.name: bytes_72
cases.note: Exactly the bcrypt input limit. The last length that works

cases.name: bytes_73
cases.note: One over. Ruby truncates and accepts it. Go refuses
